# Phase 0 survey: how much of each workbook the sheet engine recomputes as Excel saved it

*Generated by survey_report.py from runs/survey (survey.sh) or runs/survey_corpus (survey_corpus.sh). Each formula cell is recomputed by LE2's sheet engine (Formualizer, WebAssembly) from the workbook as saved, and compared with the value Excel saved for it. A cell Excel saved as an error counts as the same when the engine gives the same error.*
